  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 08, 2021

Meeting Place:  Call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
  Meeting ID: 960 5053 9618
  Passcode: 017243
  Time: 9:30 am

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the October 11, 2021, meeting.

  2. Suite Events – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing graphic
  art services for the City.

  3. Yorba Linda Feed Store, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing bales of hay for the City’s Halloween Spooktacular Event.

  4. It’s Your Party – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the services and
  refreshments provided for the Fireside Chat hosted by the City at the Regent Plaza
  Senior Homes.

  5. County of L.A Department of Animal Care and Control – Executive session to discuss
  recommend payment for providing animal care and control for the City.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.
